description: Compares buying equipment with a loan against leasing it, in today's dollars, and gives the lease's implied rate and the resale value at which buying wins.

buyout.description: Lease-end purchase price in dollars; 0 or omitted if the equipment goes back

lease.description: Monthly lease payment in dollars, paid at the start of each month

resale.description: What the equipment is expected to be worth when the lease ends, in dollars (optional)

name: compare_equipment_lease_or_buy
title: Equipment: lease or buy
